title: Particle Physics
text:
Particle physics is the branch of physics that studies the behavior of subatomic particles. It is extremely closely related to quantum mechanics. Most known physical behaviors can be explained by the Standard Model of quantum mechanics, but some phenomena (e.g. gravity) remain unknown.

The standard Model contains 14 particles, divided into fermions(fractional spins) and bosons(integer spins). Ex: A quark is a fermion, yet an photon is a boson.
